readings.moment: The temple struck ten while Girard sat alone in the dining room after dinner.
Girard went out into the street at twenty-one minutes past ten by his watch.
The piano started in the salon just as he lit his cigar, at twenty-nine minutes past ten by his watch.
At twenty-six minutes to eleven by his watch he heard faint quick bells from the master's window.
He came back into the house at fourteen minutes to eleven by his watch.
The hall clock had just struck eleven when he came back in.
The hall clock's face showed two minutes past eleven when he came back in.

durations: About 21 minutes between the temple striking ten and Girard going out at 10:21 by his watch (mixes two timepieces, so approximate).
8 minutes between Girard going out at 10:21 and the piano starting at 10:29, by his watch.
5 minutes between the piano starting at 10:29 and the bells at 10:34, by his watch.
12 minutes between the bells at 10:34 and his return at 10:46, by his watch.
25 minutes outside the house, from 10:21 to 10:46 by his watch.
whereabouts: Girard dined at the Monniers' that evening.
After dinner he sat on alone in the dining room with the brandy.
He heard the temple strike ten from the dining room.
He put on his coat and went out into the street to smoke, at 10:21 by his watch.
He stayed under the front windows of the house.
He was still under the front windows when he heard the bells at 10:34 by his watch.
He came back into the house at 10:46 by his watch.
After coming back in, he went straight up to Félix in the library.
